picks.editorial_note: UW is leading and supporting four projects under DOE's Genesis Mission, a national AI-for-science initiative spanning 300+ institutions — a flagship federal bet on AI-accelerated scientific discovery with broad academic reach.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million gift is founding an entirely new College of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics at UNT, funding endowed positions and signaling growing private investment in dedicated AI higher-ed infrastructure.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's rollout of ChatGPT Edu to over 80,000 students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, marking a major industry-academia bet on preparing an 'AI native' workforce.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: A $1.2M NSF grant unites USF, Purdue, and UT Dallas to build quantum-resistant, AI-enabled security for next-generation wireless networks — federally backed research addressing a critical infrastructure vulnerability.
picks.title: USF faculty secure $1.2M NSF grant to advance quantum-secure, AI-enabled wireless networks

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory technology achieves 100x efficiency gains over conventional approaches, a hardware advance that could meaningfully change how smart devices process AI workloads at the edge.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: USF unveiled the location and design for its new $40 million Bellini College of Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity and Computing building, a concrete signal of sustained institutional investment in AI education infrastructure.
picks.title: USF President Limayem announces location, unveils plans for new Bellini College building

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh, developed with Google and Northeastern, lets users repair and fabricate AI-generated 3D models — a practical step toward making generative design tools usable for real manufacturing.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot involving CSIRO, the University of Queensland, and industry partner ResetData aims to make data centre AI workloads dynamically grid-aware, directly targeting AI's growing energy strain on power grids.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim to have solved a Millennium Prize math problem drew public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao, a high-profile dispute over how to evaluate frontier AI reasoning claims that matters for the field's credibility.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: Louisiana's Department of Health directed nearly $2.1 million to UL Lafayette, including dedicated funding for its Center for Applied Artificial Intelligence, showing state government actively channeling AI research toward rural healthcare policy needs.
picks.title: Louisiana Department of Health taps UL Lafayette to improve rural health care
